interpretation.candidate_id: Provisional inventory label. An effective listing date in this label cannot substitute for a proven UTC onboard instant.
interpretation.evidence_status: OPERATOR_COPY_CONFIRMED applies to one or more events with reviewed PDF evidence. INDEX_HINT_ONLY indicates relevant dated indexed support inside the window. UNVERIFIED covers uncertain overlap, inferred symbol spelling or unresolved lifecycle conflicts. The event-level status governs each fact.
interpretation.planned_active_months: Tentative request planning from in-window event hints or existing probe evidence. Unknown openings generally use the window start as a working bound and unknown endings may extend to the cutoff. No lifecycle continuity is implied.
interpretation.possible_additional_months: Months outside the tentative plan with no evidence sufficient to skip the key. Previous-era listings and unresolved transitions can have only possible months.
interpretation.outside_active_months: Full months proven outside the known active period. DGBUSDT May through December 2024 retains the accepted three-symbol inventory decision.
interpretation.events: Published display times remain separate from effective UTC times. A null effective value is unresolved. Settlement is a scheduled boundary, with actual delisting completion recorded only when supported.
interpretation.flags: Discovery flags carry no O2 step 2 eligibility decision. Digit prefixes are preserved. The absence of a flag does not establish a negative classification.

stage_b_request_estimate.note: Boundary probes shown only for dated events in the plan. Additional daily gap probes depend on missing monthly keys.

exclusions.notes: Pre-market spot product; no USD-M perpetual is announced
